name: Dorfstube
beschreibung: The Hotel Dorfstube is centrally located in Fieberbrunn in the Pillerseetal in Tirol. The surrounding area is characterized by the mountain backdrop of the Kitzbüheler Alpen. The accommodation offers traditionally furnished rooms, some with a balcony and mountain view. The amenities include a restaurant with cuisine from Tirol and a small wellness area with sauna. The atmosphere at the hotel is quiet and functional, without unnecessary decor. Guests who value nature experiences and are looking for a basic accommodation will find a suitable base here. The direct location makes the hotel practical for both summer and winter activities.
